moments.subtitle: OpenClaw viral with 180k GitHub stars in 3 weeks
moments.content: OpenClaw viral with 180k GitHub stars in 3 weeks, but 40k+ instances exposed without authentication

composition.aestheticNotes: Dark obsidian background with intense amber-gold radial bloom behind hero stat. Text sits sharp on top with no blur. Glitch stamp on the word '180K' for impact.
composition.colorNotes: bg:#0d0d0d fills full frame. primary:#c9a84c on stat counter. accent:#f5e6c8 on underline sweep beneath '180K'. text:#ffffff on display headline.

beat1.description: Entry: stat counter rolls 0→180K with spring settle, word-by-word slam on 'GitHub Stars', G1 warm radial bloom fires behind
beat1.timingHint: Frames 0-12: bloom opacity 0→0.6, scale 0.2→1.0. Frames 0-15: counter rolls 0→180K ease-out-expo. Frames 4-14: words slam sequentially.

holdWindow.description: Counter holds at 180K, bloom pulses gently (opacity 0.38→0.2→0.38 via Math.sin), display text breathes (scale 1.0→1.012→1.0)
holdWindow.durationHint: Frames 15-150: bloom oscillates via Math.sin(frame/45)*0.09+0.29. Text scales via Easing.inOut(sine) 2.5s loop.

beat2OrNull.description: At frame 60: T3 highlight sweep beneath '180K' word confirms the stat
beat2OrNull.timingHint: Frame 60: accent-color rect width 0→full phrase width ease-out-expo over 11 frames

moments.emphasis: The 180K star count is the hook — needs maximum visual impact with glitch-stamp energy
moments.animationPrompt: Frames 0-3: G1 warm radial bloom (amber #c9a84c) fires behind center, opacity 0→0.6 via ease-out over 15 frames. Frames 0-12: T8 stat counter rolls 0→180K with ease-out-expo, scale spring 1.0→1.07→1.0 on land. Frames 4-14: T1 word-by-word slam cascade on 'GitHub Stars' with spring({stiffness:300,damping:20}). Frames 60-71: T3 highlight sweep beneath '180K' via interpolate width 0→100% ease-out-expo. Hold: pulse-glow on bloom via Math.sin(frame/45), breathe scale on text via Easing.inOut(sine) 2.5s loop. Exit: snap-cut at frame 150.

moments.subtitle: 40k+ instances exposed without authentication
moments.content: 40k+ instances exposed without authentication, leaking API keys and credentials

composition.aestheticNotes: Slate charcoal background with notification badge cascade. Pill badges appear like iOS notifications bouncing in. Red accent signals danger.
composition.colorNotes: bg:#14171a fills frame. primary:#2d3436 on pill containers. accent:#e84118 on badge background and warning triangle. text:#f0f0f0 on type.

beat1.description: Entry: G4 pill badge cascade with spring-bouncy stagger, G8 notification badge bounces in top-right with bloom behind
beat1.timingHint: Frames 0-12: pills translateY +30→0 spring({stiffness:280,damping:20}), stagger 110ms. Frame 8: badge bounces in scale 0→1.45→1.0.

holdWindow.description: Pills breathe in unison (scale 1.0→1.028→1.0), badge pulses gently, warning icon drifts
holdWindow.durationHint: Frames 20-150: pill scale 1.0→1.028→1.0 via spring({stiffness:200,damping:14}). Badge pulse via scale 1.0→1.05→1.0. Icon drift via Math.sin(frame/90)*3.

moments.emphasis: The exposed instances number needs urgency — notification badge bounce captures attention
moments.animationPrompt: Frames 0-12: G4 pill badges enter via spring({stiffness:280,damping:20}), translateY +30→0, stagger 110ms between pills. Frame 8: G8 notification badge bounces in top-right scale 0→1.45→1.0 via spring({stiffness:200,damping:11}), G1 bloom behind badge radius 0→30px opacity 0→0.45→0.2 over 12 frames. Hold: pills breathe scale 1.0→1.028→1.0 via spring({stiffness:200,damping:14}), badge pulses via scale 1.0→1.05→1.0. Warning icon drifts translateY Math.sin(frame/90)*3. Exit: elastic-rebound at frame 150.

moments.subtitle: Full system access with shell commands
moments.content: Full system access with shell commands, file reading, messaging control; RCE exploit (8.8 severity) within 72 hours

composition.aestheticNotes: Pure black background with crimson accent. Hard-offset card with 7px shadow slides in. Bold statement text as hero.
composition.colorNotes: bg:#0a0a0a fills frame. primary:#1a1a1a on card background. accent:#c0392b on hard shadow and highlight words. text:#ffffff on all type.

beat1.description: Entry: G3 hard-offset card slides in from below with spring-snappy, L1 asymmetric split draws vertical divider
beat1.timingHint: Frames 0-12: card translateY +40→0 via spring({stiffness:350,damping:18}), boxShadow '7px 7px 0 #c0392b' visible. Frame 6: divider draws height 0→100% ease-out-expo.

holdWindow.description: Card holds with breathe scale (1.0→1.012→1.0), divider pulses subtly, CVSS counter drifts with slow-scale
holdWindow.durationHint: Frames 15-150: card scale 1.0→1.012→1.0 via Easing.inOut(sine) 2.5s loop. Counter slowly scales 1.0→1.04 via ease-in-out over full hold.

beat2OrNull.description: At frame 50: T8 stat counter shows '8.8' rolling up
beat2OrNull.timingHint: Frame 50: counter rolls 0→8.8 with ease-out-expo over 0.85s

moments.emphasis: The CVSS 8.8 severity score is critical — needs to land with force
moments.animationPrompt: Frames 0-12: G3 card enters translateY +40→0 via spring({stiffness:350,damping:18}), boxShadow '7px 7px 0 #c0392b' visible at rest. L1 vertical divider draws height 0→100% ease-out-expo frames 6-21. T10 stomp text on 'Full System Access' translateY -50→0 ease-out cubic, scale 1.25→1.0, stagger 130ms. Hold: card breathes scale 1.0→1.012→1.0 via Easing.inOut(sine) 2.5s loop. Frame 50: T8 counter rolls 0→8.8 ease-out-expo, scale spring 1.0→1.07→1.0 on land. Exit: ease-in-expo at frame 150.

moments.subtitle: Plain text credential storage
moments.content: Plain text credential storage makes keys and passwords perfect targets for malware

composition.aestheticNotes: Mocha dark background with soft amber radial gradient drift. Minimal — single hero element with generous negative space.
composition.colorNotes: bg:#1c120d fills frame. primary:#8b5e3c on icon/shape elements. accent:#e8c9a0 on key visual highlight. text:#f5ede0 on display text.

beat1.description: Entry: T5 masked text wipe reveals hero phrase cinematically, G1 warm bloom fades in behind
beat1.timingHint: Frames 0-18: mask width 100%→0 ease-out-expo revealing text from left. Frames 0-15: bloom opacity 0→0.38 scale 0.2→1.0.

holdWindow.description: Bloom drifts slowly behind hero (scale subtle pulse), text breathes with wider amplitude for floaty feel
holdWindow.durationHint: Frames 20-150: bloom scale oscillates via Math.sin(frame/60)*0.08+1.0. Text breathe scale 1.0→1.018→1.0 via Easing.inOut(sine) 2.5s loop.

moments.emphasis: The vulnerability of plain text storage needs to feel exposed and vulnerable
moments.animationPrompt: Frames 0-18: T5 masked text wipe reveals 'Plain Text Secrets' via parent overflow:hidden, mask width 100%→0 ease-out-expo. G1 bloom behind hero, opacity 0→0.38, scale 0.2→1.0 ease-out over 15 frames. Hold: bloom drifts scale Math.sin(frame/60)*0.08+1.0 (subtle). Text breathes scale 1.0→1.018→1.0 via Easing.inOut(sine) 2.5s loop. Exit: shrink-fade (scale+opacity drop ease-in) at frame 150.

moments.subtitle: Malicious plugins exploded from 341 to 800+
moments.content: Malicious plugins exploded from 341 to 800+; 20% of registry now compromised with zero moderation

composition.aestheticNotes: Burgundy jewel background. Animated data bars grow from left. Hairline separators. Authoritative editorial feel.
composition.colorNotes: bg:#2a0a12 fills frame. primary:#c0392b on progress bars. accent:#e8d5b7 on bar fills and highlights. text:#f5ede0 on all type.

beat1.description: Entry: T9 word scatter magnetic assemble on '341 → 800+', G7 animated data bars grow simultaneously
beat1.timingHint: Frames 0-18: words scatter from random offsets (±90px x, ±70px y) via spring({stiffness:200,damping:18,mass:0.9}). Bars grow width 0→target% ease-out-expo, stagger 140ms.

holdWindow.description: Bars hold at final width, arc pulses gently, words breathe in unison
holdWindow.durationHint: Frames 25-150: words breathe scale 1.0→1.012→1.0 via Easing.inOut(sine) 2.5s loop. Arc stroke oscillates opacity 0.55→0.2→0.55 via Math.sin(frame/45).

beat2OrNull.description: At frame 60: G5 progress arc draws to 20% showing the compromise rate
beat2OrNull.timingHint: Frame 40-82: arc stroke-dashoffset interpolates circumference→circumference*0.8 via ease-out

moments.emphasis: The growth from 341 to 800+ malicious plugins shows the exponential threat
moments.animationPrompt: Frames 0-18: T9 word scatter on '341 → 800+' springs from random offsets via spring({stiffness:200,damping:18,mass:0.9}), ±15ms delay variation. G7 bars grow width 0→target% ease-out-expo, stagger 140ms. Frames 40-82: G5 progress arc draws stroke-dashoffset circumference→circumference*0.8 ease-out. Hold: words breathe scale 1.0→1.012→1.0 2.5s loop, arc pulse-glow via Math.sin(frame/45). Exit: ease-in-expo at frame 150.

moments.subtitle: Prompt injection attacks
moments.content: Prompt injection attacks hide malicious commands in emails; AI executes them silently without user knowledge

composition.aestheticNotes: Forest green dark background. Bottom info strip slides up like a notification. Amber accent on the 'injection' warning.
composition.colorNotes: bg:#0f1f14 fills frame. primary:#2d6a4f on info strip background. accent:#e9a824 on warning highlight and underline. text:#e8f5e9 on type.

beat1.description: Entry: L2 bottom-third info strip slides up after hero lands, T1 word cascade on 'Hidden Commands'
beat1.timingHint: Frames 0-10: hero text lands via spring-snappy. Frame 10: strip translateY +100%→0 spring-snappy. Frame 14: pills opacity 0→1 stagger 110ms.

holdWindow.description: Strip holds with breathe, pills pulse together, amber underline glows on 'injection'
holdWindow.durationHint: Frames 20-150: strip scale 1.0→1.012→1.0 via Easing.inOut(sine) 2.5s loop. Pill pulse via scale 1.0→1.028→1.0. Underline glows via bloom pulse.

moments.emphasis: The silent execution aspect is the scary part — needs visual punch
moments.animationPrompt: Frames 0-10: 'Hidden Commands' enters via T1 word slam cascade spring({stiffness:300,damping:20}). Frame 10: L2 bottom strip slides up translateY +100%→0 via spring-snappy. Frame 14-24: G4 pill badges cascade translateY +30→0 via spring({stiffness:280,damping:20}), stagger 110ms. Hold: strip breathes scale 1.0→1.012→1.0 2.5s loop, pills pulse scale 1.0→1.028→1.0, underline glows via G1 bloom pulse-glow. Exit: snap-cut at frame 150.

moments.subtitle: Lethal trifecta: data access, untrusted content, external comm
moments.content: Lethal trifecta: private data access, untrusted content exposure, external communication ability

moments.animationPrompt: Frames 0-15: G12 card stack enters translateY +60→0 via spring({stiffness:260,damping:20}). moments.subtitle: Cisco names OpenClaw as how NOT to do AI security
moments.content: Cisco names OpenClaw as how NOT to do AI security; Sophos recommends blocking entirely

composition.aestheticNotes: Clay white background with film grain overlay. Pure typographic poster — bold statement as hero. Dark accent provides contrast.
composition.colorNotes: bg:#f5f0e8 fills frame. primary:#b5541a on accent elements. accent:#2d2d2d on underline/highlight. text:#1a1207 on all type.

beat1.description: Entry: T5 masked text wipe reveals 'Block It' cinematically, grain overlay fades in, logos stagger in

holdWindow.description: Text breathes with slow-scale (1.0→1.04), grain animates subtly, logos drift
holdWindow.durationHint: Frames 20-150: text scale 1.0→1.04 via ease-in-out over full hold duration. Grain cycles 3 frames at 12fps via Math.floor(frame/2.5)%3. Logos drift via Math.sin(frame/80)*2.

beat2OrNull.description: At frame 60: T11 split word color shift on 'Block' — word turns accent color with radial glow behind
beat2OrNull.timingHint: Frame 50: I1 flash-cut interrupt (accent flash opacity 0→0.35→0 over 10 frames). Frame 60: T11 color shift on 'Block' via interpolate 18 frames ease-out, radial glow behind radius 0→45px.

moments.emphasis: The final recommendation from Cisco/Sophos needs to feel definitive and cautionary
moments.animationPrompt: Frames 0-18: T5 masked text wipe reveals 'Block It' via parent overflow:hidden, mask width 100%→0 ease-out-expo. G2 grain overlay fades in opacity 0→0.15. Frames 10-20: company logos stagger opacity 0→1 ease-out. Hold: text slow-scales 1.0→1.04 via ease-in-out over full hold. Grain cycles via Math.floor(frame/2.5)%3. Frame 50: I1 flash-cut interrupt accent flash. Frame 60-78: T11 'Block' shifts text-color→accent-color via interpolate 18 frames, radial glow behind radius 0→45px opacity 0→0.55→0.35.
